purpose: Define placement of an exact MetaModule instance/composition onto a page/region without transferring MetaModule semantic ownership to nanoCMS.

topics.name: nanoCMS MetaModule Placement
topics.purpose: Define placement of an exact MetaModule instance/composition onto a page/region without transferring MetaModule semantic ownership to nanoCMS.

semantics.ownership_rule: nanoCMS owns placement, MetaModule owns composition semantics, constituents retain their own semantics.
semantics.multiplicity_rule: Same MetaModule may be placed multiple times through explicit placement identities.
semantics.authority_rule: Placement does not grant MetaModule execution/data authority.

invariants.rule: UI visibility, navigation, placement, styling, selection, focus and visual adjacency never create semantic ownership, resource identity or execution authority.
Effect-capable UI actions create explicit candidate/request data and must cross canonical validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before effects occur.
